name: PUTextInput
description: Single-line text input with a floating label. Supports text, email, password, tel, number, and url input types. Password variant includes a built-in show/hide toggle.

anatomy.label: Rests inside the field when empty. Floats to top-left (top: -11px, left: 6px) when focused or filled.
anatomy.input: Full-bleed inside the container, 16px horizontal padding
anatomy.passwordToggle: Eye icon button at right edge — only rendered for type=password
anatomy.errorMessage: 12px text beneath the container — only rendered when error prop is set

props.name: type
props.type: text | email | password | tel | number | url
props.description: HTML input type. password activates show/hide toggle.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown below the field. Also sets the border and label to error colour.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and reduces opacity to 40%.

props.name: labelBg
props.description: Background colour of the surface this input sits on. Used to mask the border behind the floating label.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id for the input element. Auto-generated if omitted.
